compiled_state.title: Audit and confirm no inline cycle counter exists in shell scripts; update .test-index
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD7: Old cycle-count mechanism (if any inline counter exists in sprint or review workflow) is removed and replaced by ledger reads

## Overview
Audit all shell scripts (`.sh` files) in `plugins/dso/` and `.claude/` for any inline cycle counter variable (e.g., `cycle_count`, `review_cycle`, inline integer tracking of review rounds) that duplicates the functionality of `cycle-ledger.json`. If found, remove or replace with a read from `cycle-ledger.json`. If none exist (likely, based on pre-planning grep), document the audit result in a comment on this story ticket.

Pre-work search (run before implementing) confirms no inline cycle counter exists in shell scripts:
```bash
grep -rn "cycle_count\|CYCLE_COUNT" plugins/dso/scripts/ .claude/scripts/ --include="*.sh"
```
The `DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE` env var in `runner.py` (Python, not shell) is a separate mechanism used by the CI runner, NOT the arbiter's per-epic counter — it is out of scope for this story.

## Implementation Steps
1. Run the audit grep above and record the result
2. If any inline shell counter is found: remove it and add a `write-cycle-ledger.sh` call instead
3. If none found (expected): confirm the DD is satisfied, write the audit result to a ticket comment on the story
4. Update `.test-index` if any files were removed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Grep for inline cycle counters in shell scripts returns zero hits
  Verify: ! grep -rn "cycle_count=\|CYCLE_COUNT=" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/" --include="*.sh" | grep -v "write-cycle-ledger\|test-write-cycle-ledger"
- [ ] Grep for old inline cycle accumulation pattern returns zero hits in shell scripts
  Verify: ! grep -rn "^\s*cycle_count=\$((.*+\s*1))" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/" --include="*.sh"
- [ ] Audit result is documented (either: no counter found, or: counter found and removed with commit reference)
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show aead-ae88-6e97-476b | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(any('audit' in str(c).lower() or 'DD7' in str(c) for c in d.get('comments',[])) or 'no inline' in d.get('description','').lower())"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — no shell files were modified or modifications pass shellcheck
  Verify: bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-portability.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
